newsitem.title: USA: Duramed can't predict FDA decision.
newsitem.headline: Duramed can't predict FDA decision.

text.p: Duramed Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Thursday that it is unable to predict when the U.S. Food and Drug Administration will make a decision about generic conjugated estrogens.
The company said it has an application with the FDA for a generic version of Premarin, an estrogen replacement. American Home Products Corp makes Premarin.

Duramed said it is aware of comments attributed to an FDA official that a scientific conclusion has been made on generic conjugated estrogens, but the company said it cannot predict when the FDA will announce its decision.
Duramed and the Food and Drug Administration were not immediately available for comment.
